mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering the blood and then taking useful substances back was most worthwhile. It explained why the kidney needs both steps instead of just picking out waste.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the ureters and bladder was straightforward, but less interesting than following what happened to the filtered fluid.

surprise.text: The filter let glucose and other useful small substances through along with waste, rather than separating out only waste.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary: the pictures and goals gave the parts clear purposes, although fitting the bladder was the only offered action at that point.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter: following the filtered fluid and seeing how the separate routes connect was interesting.
